__comment: Thresholds for What/How/Why (Quoi/Comment/Pourquoi) coverage detection. Coverage evidence phrases themselves are extracted by an LLM (coverage_detector.py) — this file no longer holds a per-language lexicon.

thresholds.__comment: A phase status requires BOTH a minimum rate (hits per 100 tokens) AND a minimum absolute hit count. Rate keeps long rambling transcripts from being rewarded for mere length; absolute floor keeps short vacuous clips from being rewarded for sparsity. Tune empirically once real transcripts are available.
thresholds.__plateau_note: Plateau fires when the LAST two annotations added fewer than 'plateau_epsilon_hits' hits to each of the three phase aggregates.
